_Five-hat audit: strategist · engineer · tester · debugger · designer_

**Date:** 2026-09-20 · **Release audited:** v0.1 · **Type:** full audit · **Generated by:** claude-cli

| Monday | Colourful work OS with boards, automations and dashboards. | Flexibility, automations, dashboards, templates. |

## 4. What makes us different — the four pillars (re-validated)

**Plan and track.** Workspaces → projects → phases → tasks with Kanban, Gantt, Calendar, WBS, goals and recurrence. _Features: Quick-add with natural-language dates/tags/priority, Kanban with phase swim-lanes and project segments, Gantt with draggable bars and dependencies, Calendar drag-to-reschedule, WBS codes and progress roll-up, Strategic goals linked to projects, Templates for tasks and projects, Recurring tasks._

**Log and report.** Activity log with hours, blockers and attachments feeding Review, Analytics, Work Performed, Artifacts and exports. _Features: Log activity with hours, status, bottleneck, files/links, Denormalised counters on tasks, Activity table with bulk actions and CSV import/export, Review KPIs and AI summaries, Analytics and Work Performed views, Artifacts index of attachments, JSON backup export._

**Collaborate securely.** Google sign-in with superadmin approval, workspace and project ACLs, invites, presence, comments and chat. _Features: Approval-gated onboarding, Workspace roles (owner/admin/editor/viewer), Project-level sharing and invite links, Assignees incl. external names, Task comments with Markdown, Presence indicators, Workspace chat (DMs and groups), Companies with per-company AI budgets._

**AI-assisted execution.** A local Claude Code bridge (or API key) powers task drafting, subtasks, prompts, Ask AI, due-task run and NotebookLM grounding. _Features: Provider detection with honest degraded states, Generate tasks from a project description, Generate subtasks and deliverable prompts, Ask AI with computed digests and confirm-before-write actions, Due-task alert with runnable prompt, NotebookLM knowledge base grounding and citations, Usage and cost logging in the bridge._

## 6. World-class additions

| # | Addition | Borrowed / adapted from | Why it matters here |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Configurable table views (columns, group, sort) | Airtable / Notion | Process owners live in tables; today only activities have a table and saved views store no layout. |
| 2 | Automation rules engine | Monday | Replaces the dead Webhooks UI with visible, plain-language when/then rules that run server-side. |
| 3 | Weekly timesheet with Excel export | Monday time tracking | Hours are already logged per activity; managers need per-person weekly totals to approve or bill. |
| 4 | Mentions + personal inbox | Notion / Monday notifications | Comments and assignments currently go unseen; an inbox closes the loop for teams. |
| 5 | Workload planner by week | Monday Workload view | Dashboard team-load numbers exist; drag-to-rebalance prevents the overdue pile-ups the Dashboard reports. |
| 6 | Import wizard for tasks/projects | Airtable import | Migration from spreadsheets is the first thing a new team does; the importer only handles activities. |
| 7 | Process template gallery | Notion templates | The audience is 'anyone with a process to run'; one-click process packs remove the blank-slate problem. |
| 8 | Undo toast + Trash | Notion / Airtable | Copy promises restore-ability that the UI cannot deliver. |
| 9 | Command palette that creates | Linear / Notion ⌘K | Gives the Grok-like quick-create path for every object, not just tasks. |
| 10 | Portfolio status report PDF | Monday dashboards | RAG health is computed already; executives need it as a dated file. |
| 11 | Read-only share links | Airtable share view | Clients and stakeholders can follow a Gantt without an approved account. |
| 12 | Scheduled recurrence | Monday / Notion recurring items | Rituals that are never completed still need to reappear; on-completion spawning misses them. |

## 7. Suggested build order

### Release v0.2

1. BUG-001 — Any user can self-assign a company and read its AI key (S)
2. BUG-002 — Invite links let any signed-in user become project admin (M)
3. BUG-003 — Approval gate is client-side only; pending users can write data (M)
4. BUG-004 — Next recurring task is created without workspaceId (S)
5. IMP-002 — Bridge lets web pages set the executable it spawns (S)
6. IMP-004 — No error boundary; render errors blank the app (S)
7. IMP-005 — Tests cover only bridge parsing and due-alert rules (M)
8. BUG-005 — Default project setting is never applied to quick-add (S)
9. BUG-006 — 'Shared' badge can never render (S)
10. BUG-007 — Export file dates use UTC, not the user's day (S)
11. BUG-008 — Bridge API mode is labelled as subscription billing (S)
12. BUG-011 — Sidebar user block polls auth every 500 ms (S)
13. IMP-006 — Docs are stale and there is no root README (S)
14. IMP-007 — Local run needs two commands and hidden Firebase config (S)
15. IMP-009 — Overdue notification memory grows forever (S)
16. POL-003 — CLI install instructions shown to every user (S)
17. POL-004 — Stale copy: anonymous session, email notification promise (S)
18. POL-005 — Package version and deploy account hardcoded (S)
